name: @spatial-api/crs-transformer
description: Coordinate reference system normalization and projection converter using Proj4
author: Spatial API Team

scripts.build: tsc --emitDeclarationOnly && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --minify --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --minify --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --outfile=dist/index.cjs && node -e "fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.d.ts', 'dist/index.d.cts')"
